audited_source_corrections.action: Rendered the proof premise as axiomatizable, matching both the theorem statement and the immediately preceding decidability lemma; retained the frozen token key in an alignment comment.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof says merely axiomatized where its inference to decidability requires a computable axiomatization, expressed everywhere else as axiomatizable.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் முழுமையுடன் அடிகோளாக்கத்தக்கதன்மையைக் கொண்டு முந்தைய துணைத்தேற்றத்தை நேரடியாகப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating every theory with any axiom set as decidable; weakening the theorem.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The theorem's hypothesis and cited preceding result uniquely require axiomatizability.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the one-line proof now invoke exactly the hypotheses of the complete-axiomatizable implies decidable lemma?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the positive and negative evaluations of S from numeral n to natural number n.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: As in the preceding universal-relation proof, S is an external computable relation while D_S is its representing formula, but both displayed S expressions take an object-language numeral.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் S(n) மற்றும் D_S(num n) என்ற வகை வேறுபாட்டைப் பாதுகாக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating S as an object-language predicate; changing the representing instances.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The relation-representability definition and the construction of R require a natural-number input to S and a numeral term in D_S.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both external S evaluations now applied to n while every internal D_S instance retains num n?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the hash expression for D_S at numeral u with the Gödel number of the one-free-variable formula D_S(u).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: R's first argument must code a formula D(u) with free variable u, but the final line hashes D_S applied to the numeral for u, which is neither the required schema nor the previously used Gödel-number notation.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் R இன் முதல் உட்பொருளாக ஒரே கட்டற்ற மாறி u கொண்ட D_S(u) வாய்பாட்டின் கோடல் எண்ணை இடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Coding a closed numeral instance; treating num u as a free-variable placeholder.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The definition of R and the universal relation parameter both uniquely require the code of D_S(u).
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the final equivalence now use the code of the same unary formula introduced as representing S?

audited_source_corrections.action: Localized the English predicate inside the set-builder text while preserving the bound formula metavariable and formal set-builder structure.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The corollary embeds an ordinary English explanatory phrase inside a text wrapper nested within an inline mathematical set-builder.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அதே text உட்பரப்பில் முதல்தரத் தருக்கத்தில் நிறுவத்தக்கது என்று மொழிபெயர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving public-facing English prose untranslated; restructuring the formal set-builder.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The nested dollar delimiters make the QA extractor expose the text fragment, although the TeX text wrapper preserves the same formal predicate role.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the set-builder now read naturally in Tamil while retaining the exact bound variable and theorem-set meaning?

audited_source_corrections.action: Added consistency to the first ZFC corollary, matching the immediately preceding general theorem.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The theorem says that no consistent extension is decidable, but the corollary drops consistency and thereby falsely excludes the inconsistent theory, a decidable extension of ZFC in which every sentence is provable.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தொடர்விளைவு ZFC இன் முரணற்ற, தீர்மானிக்கத்தக்க விரிவாக்கம் இல்லை என்று தேற்றத்தின் சரியான தகுதியை வைத்திருக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the false unrestricted corollary; silently treating every extension as consistent.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding theorem supplies exactly this qualification, and the chapter earlier explicitly notes that an inconsistent theory is decidable.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corollary now follow directly from the stated interpretation theorem without excluding the decidable inconsistent extension?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the closing Presburger sentence from truth in the language of arithmetic to truth in the standard model.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: A language supplies syntax and cannot make sentences true; the paragraph begins by evaluating arithmetic sentences in the standard model and the Presburger comparison requires the same intended structure.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் பிரெஸ்பர்கர் முடிவிலும் வாக்கியங்களை எண்கணிதத் தரநிலை மாதிரியிலேயே மதிப்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the category error; using the vague phrase standard interpretation without matching the paragraph's established term.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately preceding comparison and the definition of true arithmetic uniquely determine the standard natural-number model.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the decidable Presburger theory now identified as the set of sentences true in the same standard model used throughout the paragraph?
